=head2 Strftime Patterns

=head3 %c (%A %d %B %Y %I:%M:%S %p) - date time format

   2008-02-05T18:30:30 = ചൊവ്വാഴ്ച 05 ഫെബ്രുവരി 2008 06:30:30 PM
   1995-12-22T09:05:02 = വെള്ളിയാഴ്‌ച 22 ഡിസംബർ 1995 09:05:02 AM
  -0010-09-15T04:44:23 = ശനിയാഴ്‌ച 15 സെപ്റ്റംബർ -10 04:44:23 AM

=head3 %x (%-d/%-m/%y) - date format

   2008-02-05T18:30:30 = %-d/%-m/08
   1995-12-22T09:05:02 = %-d/%-m/95
  -0010-09-15T04:44:23 = %-d/%-m/10

=head3 %X (%I:%M:%S %p %Z) - time format

   2008-02-05T18:30:30 = 06:30:30 PM UTC
   1995-12-22T09:05:02 = 09:05:02 AM UTC
  -0010-09-15T04:44:23 = 04:44:23 AM UTC

=head1 SUPPORT

See L<DateTime::Locale>.
